label: end-of-episode GO step (last ~10 trials), earlier onset when choosing a2
explanation: Fires almost only at GO steps (98% of mass) in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode (99% of mass in trials 90-99, none before trial 80); every activation coincides with the lowest value-head bin (value < 5.22), consistent with the episode end approaching. Onset is earlier when the agent is choosing a2 (model_act == 2 at GO, the agent own policy output at this step, used instead of the FUTURE action variable; scores identically): from ~trial 91 for a2, from ~95 for a1. Magnitude grows toward the end of the episode (ep_trial>=95 captures 86% of the top quartile vs 23% of the bottom) and is largest for a2 choices when S2 is good. Weak residual firing at D2 (2% of mass, mostly after reaching S2) and essentially never at D1 or when in_rew = 1. Not modulated by transition type, reward, or stay/switch. Simpler (phase==GO)&(ep_trial>=90) gives F1 0.71 / mass recall 0.97.

issues: The explanation says firing barely changes with reward. That is false for prev_reward, the reward the agent observed at this trial's D1. Within the claimed window, a previous no-reward moves onset about 2 trials earlier for both choices. GO firing rates by (ep_trial, model_act, prev_reward 0 vs 1): t90 a2 0.52 vs 0.22; t91 a2 0.74 vs 0.38; t92 a2 0.85 vs 0.60; t93 a1 0.34 vs 0.08; t94 a1 0.48 vs 0.15; t95 a1 0.67 vs 0.25; t96 a1 0.85 vs 0.44. Aggregated: (GO & ep_trial>=91 & prev_reward==0) has precision 0.78, vs 0.58 when prev_reward==1. For a1 at ep_trial>=95 it is 0.87 vs 0.52.

The test-split false positives of the original predicate are mostly GO steps with r1 (previous trial rewarded), mainly a1 at trials 95-96 and a2 at trials 91-92. This is the same systematic onset shift, not scattered noise.

Onset is graded rather than a step at 91 or 95: the a2 rate rises 0.09 (t87) -> 0.28 (t89) -> 0.52 (t90) after r0. This suggests the feature tracks a low expected-value signal more than a trial count. (GO & value<4) alone gives P 0.91, R 0.67, F1 0.77 on dev.

The other claims check out. GO holds 98% of the mass, D2 2% and D1 almost none. Firing is zero before trial 80 and all of it is in the lowest value bin. The a2-earlier onset is real (t95 a1 rate 0.25-0.67 vs a2 0.94-1.0). Firing is weakly higher when good==S2. Observed-only variables are used (model_act, not the future action).
Minor: in_rew=-1 (penalty) and d1_err steps fire at high rates (52% and 19%) but hold only about 2% of the mass. The predicate does not mention them.
